purpose: Create a focused, educational promotional email draft with one clear next action.

editorial_guidelines.tone: Use the retrieved PMM voice, adapted to this channel; no fixed writing script.
guidance: Use a descriptive subject matching the message; preview text adds context instead of repeating it.
Lead with one flavor idea. Keep the body easy to scan and end with one clear CTA.
Do not invent recipient identity, merge-tag values, sender credentials, purchase links, offers or urgency.

review_criteria: Subject, preview, headline and body are consistent and non-deceptive.
CTA destination and any promotional terms require explicit trusted evidence/authorization, not assumptions.
